reports.desc: I saw their ad on Amazon and decided to order Rosabella beet pills.  I paid $72.00 for 6 bottles, buy 3, get 3 free it said.  My card was debited and I never received the product.  I want my back.  It is a scam.
I ordered two toys for grandchildren. 4 emails later, no response. They scammed me for 160.00 dollars.
Readers digest, won new mercedes 2.5 million sent 2 amazon cards 500.00 and. One for 485.00 now they want 2500.for delivery fee on a paper scratch card

WinRed has fraudulently charged me at least four times on my credit card in order to force me to contribute without my consent. I have disputed this each time, and they keep doing it. I never signed up for reoccurring charges. There is no way to get ahold of anyone. They have a phone number and an email address support@winred.com that no one will respond to. The only way of receiving a refund is by going through my credit card.
Bought 2 Kobalt batteries.  UMB helped this fraud be done to me

Ordered on July 16th. Said it was delivered on August 8th. Handed off to a person and I never received.  No customer service only email and they keep sending me the tracking show. It was handed off to an individual.

A man called me using a local area code asking me if I would be home to sign a legal document. When I said no he told me I needed to call National Document Services at (888) 980-5825 and that he would put my account on hold for 30 minutes to give me time to settle the issue.

They said I was award money for scrolling wouldn’t let me back out of page and next thing I knew money was being taken out of my account from my virtual wallet on my phone I am struggling to dispute charges as they are still pending and they took everything in my account
They keep calling everyday trying to collect a debt from 2018
They got my name, address and account info which I had to cancel that card.

I received three packages in the mail that I did not order thinking it is a brushing scam. The first two packages I threw away because that’s what it said to do online but I have pictures of everything. The third package I still have is unopened and it has a USPS shipping label tracking number 9400136208423334180821.

The scam company represented itself as a company in Greenville, SC however no such company exists. The supposed owner “Margot” does not exist either. They have no address and no phone number, and the clothing items are not authentic. They don't even have the label required by federal law.
Recieve in the mail are very official looking “final notice” with my mortgage company info all over, saying it was an allocated waiver, and appeared to be a check for me.

They have contacted me several times stating that someone is going to take my trademark and that I need to let them register it for me. Also if I do not that they will file for the "other applicant" and then sue me for using my name.
